name: Encounter Among the Waves
source:
A short moment between a clumsy hiker and the sea monster who saved him from drowning.

[from [url=https://onedismay.itch.io/encounter-among-the-waves]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一個笨手笨腳的健行者差點溺死，被海怪救了起來。這是他們共處的短短一刻。
